name: Bakery
description: Localize KiCad symbols, footprints, and 3D models to project libraries
description_full: Bakery automates the process of copying global library symbols, footprints, 3D models, and datasheets into project-local libraries. This ensures project portability by eliminating external library dependencies and provides version stability by preventing changes when global libraries are updated. Features include dual scanning of PCB and schematic files, mandatory KiCad-compatible project ZIP backups, progress tracking with detailed logging, and support for KiCad 10.
